items.sectionHelpMessage: Provide connection parameters to interact securely with the target application.

attributes.name: locked
attributes.description: Whether the account is locked (inverse of SAP IAS active flag)

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Whether the account is active in SAP IAS

attributes.name: sapUserId
attributes.description: SAP user ID from SCIM extension (e.g. P000001)

attributes.name: sapUserUuid
attributes.description: SAP user UUID from SCIM extension

attributes.name: manager
attributes.description: Manager id (vwgManagerUID) from SAP custom extension customAttribute7

attributes.name: validFrom
attributes.description: Account validity start date from SAP extension

attributes.name: validTo
attributes.description: Account validity end date from SAP extension

attributes.name: isEmailVerified
attributes.description: Whether the primary email address is verified

attributes.name: groups
attributes.description: Groups the user is a member of

attributes.name: loginName
attributes.description: Login name from SAP IAS SCIM extension

attributes.name: vwgPersonenStatus
attributes.description: Person status from PAG carisma extension

attributes.name: companyCode
attributes.description: Company code (H* except H055) from PAG carisma extension

attributes.name: mgmtLevel
attributes.description: Management level identifier from PAG carisma extension

attributes.name: vwgResponsible
attributes.description: Internal responsible person from PAG carisma extension

attributes.name: ntprimaryUserAccount
attributes.description: AD account (SAMAccountName) for SNC from PAG carisma extension

attributes.name: cisoLiso
attributes.description: CISO/LISO flag from PAG carisma extension (future)

attributes.name: externalEmail
attributes.description: Secondary email (partnerEmail/vwgMailExternal) written as emails type:other

attributes.name: x509Certificate
attributes.description: 2MFA certificate (ucActualDN) written as x509Certificates value — pending IAM clarification

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Technical name from SAP custom extension
